pred_ddx.label: Iatrogenic Ventricular Septal Defect (VSD) post-septal myectomy

Ventricular Septal Defect (VSD): The patient has a history of interventricular septal hypertrophy and underwent septal myectomy. The echocardiogram shows an abnormal color flow signal arising from the interventricular septum with a predominant flow away from the transducer into the left ventricular cavity, consistent with a VSD. The continuous and pulse wave Doppler interrogation demonstrating a continuous flow with a predominant diastolic component further supports this diagnosis.
